overview:
NY-14 is a heavily Democratic-leaning district, and incumbent Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is running for reelection with a dominant financial position. She has raised more than $32 million and holds over $15 million in cash, while her Republican opponent has raised under $350,000 with minimal cash on hand. No outside groups are spending against her in this race.

With no general-election polling available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the resource gap, all of which point strongly to the incumbent. Prediction markets price her chances at roughly 96 percent. The expected margin is about 25 points, consistent with the quantitative baseline, and the race is rated Safe Democratic.
